result_solid: CH4-channel HAT barrier: NEVPT2 raises it ~+10 kcal/mol over DFT for every metal-free abstractor (O 47->57, NH 64->74, CH2 50->58, O2 122->122) — DFT systematically underestimates metal-free HAT, same as on Mn=O.
result_directional: correlation shifts ΔΔE‡ by a uniform +8 kcal/mol (NEVPT2 vs DFT) across all 4 mediators — same anti-BEP DIRECTION as Mn=O (Stage 15/16).
honest_limit: absolute ΔΔE‡ (~+86 kcal/mol) is UNPHYSICAL: ethane C-H is weaker than methane's, so true ΔΔE‡ should be ~0/negative. The rigid collinear ethyl TS geometry inflates the C2H6 barrier. Rigid-TS is adequate for the symmetric CH4 channel and for the correlation SHIFT, but NOT for the absolute two-substrate ΔΔE‡. A relaxed ethyl TS is needed for a clean metal-free sign number.
verdict: I2 PLAUSIBLE, DIRECTIONALLY SUPPORTED, not yet a clean sign-flip. Parked pending relaxed-TS recompute; the metal system (I1, Stage 16) carries the proven anti-BEP result.
